author: opencode-worker-6
text: Worker-6 refinement (one real code fix landed: coap_server.c msg_post referenced an undeclared 'oscore' struct — replaced with the in-scope locals is_protected/oscore_ctx/piv_len, matching the config_put twin; prj.conf + CONFIG_ZCBOR=y also added). REMAINING ROOT CAUSE, refined: LICHEN_COAP_KEYS now depends on ZCBOR (coap/Kconfig:238), but the zcbor MODULE is not in the workspace build's module list (Kconfig sources modules/zcbor/Kconfig only when the module is declared; the generated autoconf has no CONFIG_ZCBOR), so CONFIG_ZCBOR=y is an unknown symbol and LICHEN_COAP_KEYS resolves to n -> CONFIG_LICHEN_COAP_KEYS_MAX_ENTRIES undeclared -> main.c:70 fails. This is a workspace/manifest-level gap (zcbor module must be declared where west can see it, or the lichen Kconfig must vendor the include path), not a prj.conf symbol fix. The coap_dtn.c zcbor include failure in the overlay build is the same root cause. Once the module is available, the overlay build should configure and the deaddrop chain compile-verify.
